raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Purpose

Fixes #62217. Alternative to #62230.

HiSparse admits an async KV load only if its prompt fits in free host pages, but it ignores pages that earlier admitted loads still need. Two waiting loads can each hold pages the other needs. Waiting requests are never preempted, so the scheduler stalls forever with `running == []`.

Fix: reserve host pages for admitted loads, as `reserved_blocks` does for the GPU pool. The change is confined to `HiSparseSourceManager` and `HiSparseCoordinator`; the scheduler loop is unchanged.

- At admission of a load, `HiSparseSourceManager` sizes its host pages (prompt + spec decode step) and admits it only if they fit beside the pages other loads still need.
- The coordinator keeps a running total of outstanding pages (O(1) check), reduced as each load allocates its pages and dropped when the request is freed.
- Local admissions are not gated (they can be preempted), matching the GPU pool.

Alternatives: #62230 skips past held waiting requests in the scheduler loop. It changes the core loop, can starve the head of the queue, and still deadlocks when no admitted load fits.

Trade-off: a load whose host pages don't fit beside those reserved for in-flight loads waits for them, instead of being admitted and risking the deadlock.

## Test Plan

```bash
# Repro: both cases fail on main ({'first', 'second'} == {'first'}), pass here
pytest tests/v1/core/test_prefix_caching.py -k test_hisparse_admitted_async_loads_can_finish_with_nothing_running

pytest tests/v1/core/test_prefix_caching.py tests/v1/core/test_scheduler.py \
  tests/v1/kv_connector/unit/test_hisparse_connector.py \
  tests/v1/kv_connector/unit/test_hisparse_stats.py \
  tests/v1/kv_connector/unit/test_remote_prefill_lifecycle.py
pytest tests/v1/e2e/general/test_hisparse.py   # 1x H100
```

New/extended tests in `tests/v1/core/test_prefix_caching.py`:
- `test_hisparse_admitted_async_loads_can_finish_with_nothing_running`: the issue's scenario, plus an MTP case where the first load to resume has no host page for its draft tokens.
- `test_hisparse_async_admission_fits_beside_inflight_import`: boundary case, a load that exactly fits is admitted.
- `test_hisparse_import_reservation_released`: released on free and on resume.
- `test_hisparse_import_reservation_does_not_gate_local_admissions`.

## Test Result

- Unit (CPU): all pass. 3 unrelated failures (`test_async_scheduling_pp_allows_rescheduling_with_output_placeholders`, `test_draft_layer_rows_mirrored_after_drafter[FULL|NONE]`) fail identically on `main` locally.
- E2E (1x H100, `f96ae2830d`): `test_hisparse.py` 5 passed (`standalone-fa4` skips on SM90). New path exercised: in the `offload` case (HiSparse + OffloadingConnector), a coordinator probe logged the load sized at 5 pages, a 2-page reservation, and its release to 0 on resume.

## Performance

GLM-5.3-NVFP4 P/D on 8x B200: TP4 NIXL prefiller + TP4 HiSparse decoder (`MultiConnector[HiSparse, Nixl]`, `host_pool_gib=8`), `--kv-cache-dtype fp8 --block-size 64 --no-enable-prefix-caching`, `--speculative-config '{"method":"mtp","num_speculative_tokens":3}'` on both servers.

```bash
vllm bench serve --dataset-name random --random-input-len 16384 --random-output-len 512 \
  --num-prompts 128 --max-concurrency 32 --ignore-eos --seed 42
```

Fresh decoder per run, interleaved. NIXL over TCP (no IB on that node), so the run is transfer-bound with the host pool ~96% full.

| Decoder | Output tok/s (2 runs) | Mean TTFT | Mean TPOT |
|---|---|---|---|
| PR (`c02494d57c`) | 191.52, 184.44 | 68.9 s, 72.3 s | 17.00, 16.82 ms |
| `main` (`cc1a6d3135`) | 182.61, 185.10 | 73.2 s, 73.0 s | 17.26, 16.33 ms |

No regression; at most 11 of 2,949 host pages were reserved. Without MTP, a P/D load allocates all its host pages at admission and nothing is reserved, so admission matches `main` exactly (verified on an earlier revision over IB: 580–581 tok/s in both arms).
